hotspots.title: AI Colour Panel
hotspots.text: India's first AI-powered colourful display panel offers an intuitive and vibrant interface, making laundry smarter and more interactive.

hotspots.title: One-Touch AI Wash
hotspots.text: Just one touch is all it takes: it automatically senses fabric type, load, and dirt level to choose the perfect wash settings.

hotspots.title: Direct Motion Motor
hotspots.text: Built for durability and silence, this advanced motor ensures energy efficiency with smooth, vibration-free operation.

hotspots.title: Night Wash
hotspots.text: Designed for silent operation, Night Wash lets you run cycles anytime, even during the night, without disturbing your peace.
